description: Plans a token swap on one chain, a cross-chain swap or bridge, or a native-gas top-up on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, BNB Chain, Polygon or Optimism, and returns unsigned transactions for the given wallet to sign. It fits when the user wants to exchange tokens, move them between these chains, or get ETH, BNB or POL for gas. It sends nothing and moves no funds. The answer leads with blocking notices and warnings, then gives the route's outcome kind (an exact amount or one that can vary; with a swap on arrival, the token, else a named fallback; where a transfer can go unfilled, a refund of the bridged token on the source chain hours later), every third-party cost except network gas, the expected time, validUntil and the calls in signing order. The main call can carry gas, the recommended gas limit: use it as the transaction's gas limit, and without it estimate with a priority fee above zero. A blocking notice returns no calls; a warning, or a recipient other than the wallet, sets requiresConfirmation, and the connection's settings can turn either into a refusal. Calls sent after validUntil are stale: they can revert or, on some routes, end in a refund hours later. Amounts are decimal strings in token units; tokens are listed symbols or contract addresses; the recipient defaults to the wallet. Limits set in the connection (a pinned wallet, a per-plan USD cap, listed tokens only) bound every argument. For an ambiguous symbol, cleave_find_token lists the candidates; after sending, cleave_track_swap reports progress. A wallet with no gas can get it with cleave_get_gas.

amount.description: A decimal amount in token units

buyToken.description: A listed symbol or a contract address

fromChainId.description: The chain of the token to sell

maxSlippageBps.description: The maximum slippage in basis points, from 0 to 5000, and at least 1 for a cross-chain plan that swaps on both chains; 50 when omitted

recipient.description: The address that receives the bought token; the wallet when omitted

sellToken.description: A listed symbol or a contract address

toChainId.description: The chain of the token to buy; fromChainId when omitted

wallet.description: The wallet that sells the token and signs the returned calls

name: cleave_plan_swap
title: Plan a swap, bridge or gas top-up
